SET @prov_c := '%s';
SET @id:= '%s';
SET @cat_id := '%s';
SET @send :=  IF((SELECT active FROM sys_report WHERE cat_id = @cat_id and id = @id )=1,0,2);
SET @b_year:=(SELECT yearprocess FROM pk_byear LIMIT 1);
SET	@start_d:=concat(@b_year-1,'1001');
SET @end_d:=concat(@b_year,'0930');

CALL AddCol('hdc','s_rdu9','target1',' int(9) DEFAULT 0 ');
CALL AddCol('hdc','s_rdu9','result1',' int(9) DEFAULT 0 ');

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS s_rdu9(
  id varchar(32) NOT NULL,
  hospcode varchar(5) NOT NULL,
  areacode varchar(8) NOT NULL,
  flag_sent varchar(1) DEFAULT NULL,
  date_com varchar(14) DEFAULT NULL,
  b_year varchar(4) NOT NULL,
	target int(9) DEFAULT 0,
	result  int(9) DEFAULT 0,
	target1 int(9) DEFAULT 0,
	result1  int(9) DEFAULT 0,
PRIMARY KEY (id,hospcode,areacode,b_year),
	KEY (hospcode),
	KEY (areacode),
	KEY (b_year)
) ENGINE=MyISAM DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8;

DELETE FROM s_rdu9 WHERE id=@id AND b_year=(@b_year+543);

DROP TEMPORARY TABLE IF EXISTS t_rdu_labor;
CREATE TEMPORARY TABLE IF NOT EXISTS t_rdu_labor (
BDATE date DEFAULT NULL,
BHOSP VARCHAR(5)  DEFAULT NULL,
BTYPE VARCHAR(1)  DEFAULT NULL,
BRESULT VARCHAR(7)  DEFAULT NULL,
LABOR DECIMAL(1,0) DEFAULT 0,
DIAG_IPD DECIMAL(1,0) DEFAULT 0,
DATE_ADMIT date DEFAULT NULL,
DATE_DISCH date DEFAULT NULL,
DIAGCODE text,
DIAGTYPE text,
PRIMARY KEY(hospcode,pid), KEY(hospcode,pid) ) IGNORE AS
SELECT
	l.HOSPCODE,l.PID,0 as LABOR ,l.BDATE,l.BHOSP,l.BTYPE,l.BRESULT
	,0 AS DIAG_IPD,NULL AS DATE_ADMIT,NULL AS DATE_DISCH,NULL AS DIAGCODE,NULL AS DIAGTYPE
FROM t_labor  l  
INNER JOIN chospital h ON l.hospcode = h.hoscode AND h.hostype IN(5,6,7,11) 
INNER JOIN t_person_db p ON l.hospcode=p.hospcode AND l.PID=p.pid
WHERE  l.btype NOT IN(6) AND l.bdate BETWEEN @start_d AND @end_d AND l.hospcode=l.BHOSP
GROUP BY l.hospcode,l.pid;

INSERT IGNORE INTO t_rdu_labor(
SELECT
l.HOSPCODE,l.PID, 0 ,NULL ,NULL ,NULL,NULL, 0
,DATE_FORMAT(DATETIME_ADMIT,'%Y%m%d') DATE_ADMIT
,DATE_FORMAT(DATETIME_DISCH,'%Y%m%d') DATE_DISCH
,GROUP_CONCAT(l.DIAGCODE ORDER BY DATE_FORMAT(DATETIME_ADMIT,'%Y%m%d'),l.diagtype) DIAGCODE 
,GROUP_CONCAT(l.DIAGTYPE ORDER BY DATE_FORMAT(DATETIME_ADMIT,'%Y%m%d'),l.diagtype) DIAGTYPE
FROM tmp_diag_ipd l
INNER JOIN chospital h ON l.hospcode = h.hoscode AND h.hostype IN(5,6,7,11) 
INNER JOIN t_person_db p ON l.hospcode=p.hospcode AND l.PID=p.pid
WHERE  (SUBSTR(DIAGCODE,1,3) IN('O80','O81','O82','O83','O84')
							OR SUBSTR(DIAGCODE,1,4)  in('O601','O602','O603'))
AND DATE_FORMAT(DATETIME_ADMIT,'%Y%m%d') BETWEEN @start_d AND @end_d 
GROUP BY l.hospcode,l.pid);


UPDATE  t_rdu_labor l INNER JOIN  (
SELECT
l.HOSPCODE,l.PID
,DATE_FORMAT(DATETIME_ADMIT,'%Y%m%d') DATE_ADMIT
,DATE_FORMAT(DATETIME_DISCH,'%Y%m%d') DATE_DISCH
,GROUP_CONCAT(l.DIAGCODE ORDER BY DATE_FORMAT(DATETIME_ADMIT,'%Y%m%d'),l.diagtype) DIAGCODE 
,GROUP_CONCAT(l.DIAGTYPE ORDER BY DATE_FORMAT(DATETIME_ADMIT,'%Y%m%d'),l.diagtype) DIAGTYPE
FROM tmp_diag_ipd l
INNER JOIN chospital h ON l.hospcode = h.hoscode AND h.hostype IN(5,6,7,11) 
INNER JOIN t_person_db p ON l.hospcode=p.hospcode AND l.PID=p.pid
WHERE  (SUBSTR(DIAGCODE,1,3) IN('O80','O81','O82','O83','O84')
							OR SUBSTR(DIAGCODE,1,4)  in('O601','O602','O603'))
AND DATE_FORMAT(DATETIME_ADMIT,'%Y%m%d') BETWEEN @start_d AND @end_d 
GROUP BY l.hospcode,l.pid
) d ON l.hospcode=d.hospcode AND l.pid=d.pid 
SET  l.DATE_ADMIT=d.DATE_ADMIT,l.DATE_DISCH=d.DATE_DISCH,l.DIAGCODE=d.DIAGCODE,l.DIAGTYPE=d.DIAGTYPE;

UPDATE t_rdu_labor  l INNER JOIN  (
SELECT
i.HOSPCODE,i.PID
,DATE_FORMAT(DATETIME_ADMIT,'%Y%m%d') DATE_ADMIT
,DATE_FORMAT(DATETIME_DISCH,'%Y%m%d') DATE_DISCH
FROM tmp_diag_ipd i
INNER JOIN chospital h ON i.hospcode = h.hoscode AND h.hostype IN(5,6,7,11) 
INNER JOIN t_person_db p ON i.hospcode=p.hospcode AND i.PID=p.pid
WHERE  SUBSTR(DIAGCODE,1,4)  in('O800') AND DIAGTYPE in(1)
AND DATE_FORMAT(DATETIME_ADMIT,'%Y%m%d') BETWEEN @start_d AND @end_d 
GROUP BY i.hospcode,i.pid
)  d ON l.hospcode=d.hospcode AND l.pid=d.pid 
SET l.DIAG_IPD=1 
WHERE  INSTR(l.DIAGCODE,'O800');

UPDATE t_rdu_labor SET LABOR=1 
WHERE   INSTR(BRESULT,'O800') AND  BTYPE IN(1);


INSERT IGNORE INTO s_rdu9
(
SELECT
@id,l.hospcode,concat(h.provcode,SUBSTR(CONCAT('00',h.distcode),-2),SUBSTR(CONCAT('00',h.subdistcode),-2),SUBSTR(CONCAT('00',h.mu),-2)) as areacode
,@send,DATE_FORMAT(now(),'%Y%m%d%H%i%s') as d_com,@b_year+543 as b_year

,COUNT(DISTINCT IF(l.labor IN(1),CONCAT(l.hospcode,'-',l.pid),NULL)) t1
,COUNT(DISTINCT IF(l.labor IN(1) 
AND d.CHK_ANB = 'Y' AND SUBSTR(d.DIDSTD,17,1) IN(1,2,3) AND d.scount in(1)
	AND (DATE_FORMAT(d.DATETIME_ADMIT,'%Y-%m-%d')  BETWEEN DATE_ADD(l.BDATE ,INTERVAL-2 day)  
					AND DATE_ADD(l.BDATE ,INTERVAL 2 day)
		OR  DATE_FORMAT(d.DATETIME_ADMIT,'%Y-%m-%d') BETWEEN  DATE_FORMAT(l.DATE_ADMIT,'%Y%m%d')  
					AND  DATE_FORMAT(l.DATE_DISCH,'%Y%m%d') )
 , CONCAT(l.hospcode,l.pid),NULL)) r1
,COUNT(DISTINCT IF(l.DIAG_IPD IN(1),CONCAT(l.hospcode,'-',l.pid),NULL)) t2
,COUNT(DISTINCT IF(l.DIAG_IPD IN(1)
AND d.CHK_ANB = 'Y' AND SUBSTR(d.DIDSTD,17,1) IN(1,2,3) AND d.scount in(1)
	AND (DATE_FORMAT(d.DATETIME_ADMIT,'%Y-%m-%d')  BETWEEN DATE_ADD(l.BDATE ,INTERVAL-2 day)  
					AND DATE_ADD(l.BDATE ,INTERVAL 2 day)
		OR  DATE_FORMAT(d.DATETIME_ADMIT,'%Y-%m-%d') BETWEEN  DATE_FORMAT(l.DATE_ADMIT,'%Y-%m-%d')  
					AND  DATE_FORMAT(l.DATE_DISCH,'%Y-%m-%d') )
, CONCAT(l.hospcode,l.pid),NULL)) r2
FROM t_rdu_labor l
INNER JOIN chospital h ON l.hospcode = h.hoscode AND h.hostype IN(5,6,7,11) AND h.provcode IN(@prov_c) 
INNER JOIN t_person_db p ON l.hospcode=p.hospcode AND l.PID=p.pid
LEFT JOIN tmp_drug_asu_ipd  d  ON l.hospcode=d.HOSPCODE AND l.PID=d.PID 
GROUP BY l.hospcode
);

DROP TEMPORARY TABLE IF EXISTS tx;
CREATE TEMPORARY TABLE IF NOT EXISTS tx(
SELECT
h.hoscode as hospcode, h.hosname, p.PID, p.CID, p.NAME, p.LNAME, p.SEX, p.BIRTH
,p.HID, p.addr, p.check_vhid, p.NATION, p.TYPEAREA
,l.BDATE,l.BHOSP,l.BTYPE,l.BRESULT
,a.AN,l.DATE_ADMIT DATETIME_ADMIT,l.DATE_DISCH DATETIME_DISCH,l.DiAGCODE,l.DIAGTYPE
,GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT d.DIDSTD) DIDSTD
,GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT d.DNAME) DNAME
,GROUP_CONCAT(d.AMOUNT) AMOUNT
,GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT d.GENERIC_NAME) GENERIC_NAME
,GROUP_CONCAT(d.DATESTART) DATESTART
,GROUP_CONCAT(d.DATEFINISH) DATEFINISH
,IF(l.LABOR IN(1),'นับเป้าหมาย',null) target_l
,IF(l.DIAG_IPD IN(1),'นับเป้าหมาย',null) target_d
,IF(d.scount=1 AND d.CHK_ANB = 'Y' AND SUBSTR(d.DIDSTD,17,1) IN(1,2,3)
	AND (DATE_FORMAT(d.DATETIME_ADMIT,'%Y-%m-%d')  BETWEEN DATE_ADD(l.BDATE ,INTERVAL-2 day)  
					AND DATE_ADD(l.BDATE ,INTERVAL 2 day) 
		OR  DATE_FORMAT(d.DATETIME_ADMIT,'%Y-%m-%d') BETWEEN  DATE_FORMAT(l.DATE_ADMIT,'%Y-%m-%d')  
					AND  DATE_FORMAT(l.DATE_DISCH,'%Y-%m-%d') )	,'พบการจ่ายยาตามมาตรฐานรหัส',NULL) result
FROM t_rdu_labor  l  
INNER JOIN chospital h ON l.hospcode = h.hoscode AND h.hostype IN(5,6,7,11) 
INNER JOIN t_person_db p ON l.hospcode=p.hospcode AND l.PID=p.pid
LEFT JOIN tmp_admission a ON l.hospcode=a.HOSPCODE AND l.PID=a.PID AND l.DATE_ADMIT = DATE_FORMAT(a.DATETIME_ADMIT,'%Y-%m-%d')
LEFT JOIN tmp_drug_asu_ipd  d  ON l.hospcode=d.HOSPCODE AND l.PID=d.PID 
WHERE  l.labor IN(1) OR l.diag_ipd in(1)  
GROUP BY l.HOSPCODE,l.PID
);
SELECT
h.hoscode, h.hosname, d.PID, d.CID, d.NAME, d.LNAME, d.SEX
,d.BIRTH, d.HID, d.addr, d.check_vhid, d.NATION, d.TYPEAREA

,d.AN,d.DATETIME_ADMIT,d.DATETIME_DISCH,d.DiAGCODE,d.DIAGTYPE
,d.DIDSTD,d.DNAME,d.AMOUNT,d.GENERIC_NAME
,d.DATESTART,d.DATEFINISH
,d.target_l,d.target_d,d.result

tx d
INNER JOIN chospital h ON d.hospcode = h.hoscode
WHERE 1=1 {where}

zone.label: เขตสุขภาพ
zone.query: SELECT h.zone_code as a_code ,h.zone_name as a_name, SUM("target") "target1" ,SUM("result") "result1" ,SUM("target1") "target" ,SUM("result1") "result"  FROM chospital_regis as h LEFT JOIN {{S_TABLE}} as s ON h.hoscode=s.hospcode AND s.b_year={{YEAR}} AND {{YYMMFREEZE}} LEFT JOIN ccmihosp ON s.hospcode = ccmihosp.hcode AND ccmihosp.byear = {{YEAR}} LEFT JOIN cmastercup ON s.hospcode = cmastercup.hsub WHERE (h.zone_code = {{ZONE_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{ZONE_CODE}}) AND (h.chw_code = {{PROVINCE_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{PROVINCE_CODE}}) AND (h.amp_code = {{DISTRICT_FULL_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{DISTRICT_FULL_CODE}}) AND (h.tmb_code = {{SUBDISTRICT_FULL_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{SUBDISTRICT_FULL_CODE}}) AND (h.dep = {{DEPARTMENT_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{DEPARTMENT_CODE}}) AND (h.mcode IN ({{ORGANIZATION_TYPE}}) or 'ALL' IN ({{ORGANIZATION_TYPE}})) AND (h.mcode IN ({{MINISTRY_CODE}}) or 'ALL' IN ({{MINISTRY_CODE}})) AND (h.hoscode IN ({{HOSPITAL_CODE}}) or 'ALL' IN ({{HOSPITAL_CODE}})) AND (ccmihosp.splevel = {{SERVICE_PLAN_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{SERVICE_PLAN_CODE}}) AND (cmastercup.hsub IN ({{HOSPITAL_CODE}}) or 'ALL' IN ({{HOSPITAL_CODE}})) GROUP BY h.zone_code,h.zone_name ORDER BY h.zone_code
